# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, yeah, thanks for taking my call. My name is Lucas Santos, I think the account might be under lucas_santos_6600.

I ordered a few things for my daughter in Chicago, but she still hasn’t received them, and I’m getting a little worried. I was hoping you could help me figure out a few things.

First, can you tell me which address the order was actually sent to? I want to make sure I didn’t accidentally send it to my place instead of hers. I live in Denver, Colorado, 80239, but the order was supposed to go to my daughter in Chicago.

Also, could you give me the tracking number and let me know whether the package is still in transit or if something else happened to it?

There was also a tablet in the order, and I wanted to check the storage size on that, because I can’t remember if I ordered the larger one or not.

And one more thing, if possible, I’d like to change my default address on the account to my daughter’s address so I don’t have to switch it every time I order something for her.

I should mention, I don’t remember what email I used on the account, so that may not help much. If there’s another way to look me up, I’d appreciate it.

Anyway… yeah, I’ve been trying to get this sorted out for a bit now. My daughter keeps asking me if I have any update,
